sentences.en: All the arrangements should be made prior to our departure.
sentences.zh: 出发前所有的安排都应该做好。

sentences.en: She was in the military prior to becoming a teacher.
sentences.zh: 她是在成为教师之前在军队服役的。

sentences.en: How was your health prior to being diagnosed with cancer?
sentences.zh: 被诊断出癌症之前的健康状况怎么样？

senses.zh: 在先的，优先的，更重要的，较早的
